fields.acceptance: A Go test in internal/run: a wait whose condition reports 75 with a stop: line ends the run stopped with that detail and the step not ended, and a resume polls the wait again; an exit other than 0 or 75 still reads as not held
fields.statement: A wait step whose condition exits 75 stops its run for the owner instead of polling on: the step is not ended, the run's stop detail is the last 'stop: ' line of the condition's output, and resuming the run runs the wait again

fields.acceptance: A ship-check-settles-conflict.txtar with a fake gh whose pr view reports mergeable CONFLICTING until a new head is pushed: with origin/main conflicting only under .rhiza/rendered, ship check --settled exits non-zero, origin's branch then contains origin/main and the ship record's pushed is the new head; with a conflict in a code file it exits 75, prints a stop: line, raises a rebase-conflict question and leaves the branch unchanged
fields.statement: rhiza ship check --settled reads the PR's mergeable state and, when GitHub reports it CONFLICTING, rebases the branch onto origin/main as rhiza ship rebase does, settling rendered-only conflicts by rendering again and recording the pushed head, then reports not settled; a conflict in code raises the rebase-conflict question, leaves the branch as it was and exits 75 with a stop: line
